name: s81lk_serdes_col_lp4
landed_note: S81-SERDES 10-19: lp.py landed column from the wires-only flat parent ot_pdie_serdes_col_flat (spec tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_pdie_serdes_col_lp4.json). Clock families (COORDINATOR LEAD-S81 10-19 11:53): clk -> ck_tx, ck_r0, ck_r1, ck_ptx, ck_rxo; pma_rck (recovered, NOT the core PLL) -> ck_syn, ck_dly, ck_chn, ck_out. The only rck->clk crossings are the CDC children u_rm (closed gray-FIFO rate matcher, elastic IDLE deletion) and u_sts (2-flop status syncs) plus the regional reset runs (>= 4 stages per region = synchronisers); no landing crosses the families. related_same_frequency is the landed-cluster STA convention (as the closed s81lk_rate_match tile); the CDC is structural, proven by tb_s81_pdie_col with die B 300 ppm slow.

reset_landing.reason: rst is landed by the lp.py regional reset runs: root stage on ck_tx + 4 registered stages per region (depth 5), each child reset run depth + t(child); no plain fanout from the port

structural_change: S81-LINK3 10-19 lpk4 (S81.STA.OWN.7): lpk3 gate2 FAIL = ck_tx one clock region over the whole 1.3 mm TX lane plus the rx/st outputs (4855 sinks, TT insertion 0.92-1.75 ns, pin spread 165 ps, setup -622 ps on relay row u_txr1; reset-root hops -126..-391 ps from the 1.5 ns tx insertion). Rebuilt structurally: TX lane = 4 clk regions in one straight E column (tx: face reg + encoder, encoder moved W->E top at 259.2,3585.6 under the tx pins; r0, r1: one relay row each; ptx: PMA TX), every hop a D4/E2 landing (2-cycle wire <= ~470 um); RX output = own clk region rxo (rate-matcher read side, status-sync clk side, 2-stage rx/st out regs up the W column to the N face, rx pins moved over the W column). RX rck regions unchanged. Cost: TX +9 edges (was +3), rx/st +8 (was +7), static, in the lp4 record compiler block. S81-SERDES 10-19 (S81.STA.OWN.7): the SerDes column as an lp.py LANDED parent (replaces the draft s81lk_serdes_col_e3, which could not gen: kind cluster + multiple_cts_roots needs an lp record). All glue moved into children (live flags, status CDC, TX face/relay rows); decoder tiles are direct children in 4 rck regions with 11 D4/E2 landings (+6 edges); TX lane enc -> 2 relay rows -> landing tx->ptx (+3 edges) -> PMA TX; rx/st output regs; PMA RX moved to the W half under dsyn, PMA TX to the E half under the TX lane drop; 518.4 x 3844.8 approved slot. lpk3 (LEAD2-S81/LINK 10-19): lpk2 failed PDN-0006 (PMA M4 PG fully under its own M5 OBS); PMA abstracts v1.1 expose PG as M5 stripes on the parent 5.4 um lattice with M5 OBS only between them, strapped M5->M6 like hard children (macros[].pg_layer M5).

job.purpose: S81 SerDes column landed parent lpk4: TX lane split into 4 landed clk regions + rxo output region (lpk3 ck_tx spread 165 fix), gate --cts
